scope: Instruction audit of the shared native body reader; not a whole-firmware equivalence claim.

factory_reference.observation: Original handler makes one receive call; it has no three-timeout reconstruction loop.

native_observations: Five-second absolute esp_timer deadline; no retry counter.
Per-read SO_RCVTIMEO uses remaining milliseconds rounded upward, never a zero/infinite final timeout.
Failed/incomplete reads shut down only the socket read side before the caller sends 400, avoiding IDF remaining-body purge waits.
Successful bodies restore the preexisting receive timeout before JSON/field processing.
